name: math-proof-demo
description: Demo of model-judged proofs: two classic International Mathematical Olympiad problems (IMO 1959 Problem 1, IMO 1964 Problem 1), one per stage. The agent writes a complete proof to answer.md; the llm-judge scorer grades it against a hidden reference solution and marking scheme (7 points per problem) with a fixed judge model, median of 3 judgements. Problem statements: the public IMO problem archive (https://www.imo-official.org/problems.aspx). Reference solutions and marking schemes written for this platform.
